name: Pactiv Evergreen - Covington GA Distribution Center

fieldNotes.truckGate: Barrier-arm gate clearly visible across the truck lane on the entry drive, with a tractor-trailer queued behind it (2020-01 Street View, multiple headings). Bollards and a 'TRUCKS' directional sign confirm a controlled truck checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small structure beside the barrier arm at the entry checkpoint, consistent with a guard booth (z19 satellite). The site is a branded 24/7 Pactiv Regional Mixing Center; barrier-arm gates of this kind are normally booth-operated.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a guard booth is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved approach area outside the barrier arm where a truck can wait (a trailer was observed queued there).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large cross-dock DC warehouse with dock doors along BOTH long faces (NE and SW), trailers backed in on both sides -> 50+ band. ~70 doors estimated; count is approximate over a very long building.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer parking on both sides of the building and at the NE end - dozens of trailers parked without tractors -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock layout with docks on two opposite long faces - shipping and receiving almost certainly run from the separate dock banks. Inferred from layout, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage / drop areas on both sides of the building - true. This is a regional mixing center, trailer-staging-heavy by nature.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two buildings on the property: the large dark-roofed cross-dock DC warehouse and the red-brick office/support building at the SW. Counted as 2 buildings but a single facility (not a multi-facility campus).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Covington GA - the Lake Forest Court industrial park is an edge-of-town/small-town setting bordered by woods. Per rubric -> Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; truck-served distribution / mixing center.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep entry drive from the barrier arm to the dock aprons holds a 3+ truck queue.
